title: Disciple of Sun
summary: Accept the Disciple of Sun's monk challenge and defeat him before his deadline.
overview: Accept the Disciple of Sun's monk challenge and defeat him before his deadline.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Have the group ready before saying challenge.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: A monk on epic 1.5 steps 12 through 16 can use the challenge dialogue.
The challenge removes his protection and immediately adds the challenger to his hate list.
Entering combat starts a 15-minute despawn timer.
